```yaml
name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
      E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
      NODE_ENV: test
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Cache pnpm store
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pnpm-store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Install ngrok
        run: |
          NGROK_URL=$(curl -s https://ngrok.com/download | grep -oP 'https://[^\s]+' | head -1)
          curl -L -o ngrok "$NGROK_URL"
          chmod +x ngrok
          ./ngrok authtoken ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Start application server
        run: pnpm run dev &
        env:
          PORT: 3000

      - name: Wait for server to be ready
        run: |
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health; then
              echo "Server is up"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Start ngrok tunnel
        run: |
          ./ngrok http 3000 --log=stdout --log-format=json > ngrok.log &
          echo "Waiting for ngrok to initialize..."
          sleep 5
          NGROK_URL=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels | jq -r '.tunnels[0].public_url')
          echo "NGROK_URL=$NGROK_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        run: pnpm run test-e2e:flows

      - name: Clean up background processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          pkill -f 'pnpm run dev' || true
          pkill -f './ngrok' || true
```
